_metadata.description: Restore is first-class: restore to a location and verify by test-restoring to scratch and checksumming.

requirements.title: Restore a target from a snapshot
requirements.description: Restore a target's snapshot to a chosen location for each source kind, using the kopia repository plus the source kind's restore step (pg restore, qdrant upload, etc.).

validation.notes: For each source kind, backup then restore to a scratch location and assert equivalence.

requirements.title: Verify mode (test-restore + checksum)
requirements.description: A verify operation test-restores a snapshot to a scratch location and checksums the result, recording a last-verified timestamp per target. This is the gate before any committed runtime data is removed from git.

validation.notes: Run verify; assert scratch is cleaned up, checksum matches source manifest, last_verified_at is set.

requirements.title: Generic snapshot audit (inventory compare)
requirements.description: A scenario-agnostic audit restores a snapshot to scratch (proving recoverability), captures the live target to scratch (read-only on live), walks both trees with one generic filesystem walker, and compares them by generic signals only: file/dir/symlink counts, regular bytes, a path-list hash, a tree content hash, and per-SQLite-file integrity/schema/page facts. It distinguishes a true mismatch from explainable drift (live newer than the snapshot), persists each proof, and exposes it across API, CLI, and UI. DBM never encodes any scenario's domain objects; reports store relative paths, counts, and hashes only — never file contents or secrets.

validation.notes: Restore + live-capture identical trees → matches=true, restorable=true; mismatch and drift covered by TestRunAudit_ContentMismatch / TestRunAudit_LiveNewerSetsDrift; scratch cleanup by TestRunAudit_ScratchCleanedUp; walker/sqlite/comparator by inventory_test.go, dbcheck_test.go, comparator_test.go.
Audit report renders pass/diff/drift/failed verdicts, mismatches, generic inventory, and SQLite integrity; the restore flow audit action is covered in ui/src/pages/RestoresPage.test.tsx.
